name: Getharvest
mood: Golden-hour productivity workspace with warm cream canvas, white floating product cards, one vivid orange action color, editorial hero serif, warm geometric UI type, and soft warm-tinted shadows.

harvestFlame.role: Primary CTA fill, active states, links, icon accents, and brand borders.

marigoldGlow.role: Soft warm highlight wash on cards and decorative glow behind product UI.

parchmentShadow.role: Warm-tinted card and image shadow color.

inkBlack.role: Primary text, icon strokes, nav borders, and card headings.

ironwood.role: Strong secondary text and emphasized muted labels.

warmStone.role: Secondary body text, list items, and muted icon strokes.

ash.role: Helper text, placeholders, and low-priority borders.

driftwood.role: Tertiary body text, decorative strokes, and subtle metadata.

graphite.role: List borders and tertiary structural lines.

smoke.role: Disabled text and very low-priority separators.

bone.role: Input borders and form field outlines at rest.

mistGray.role: Hairline dividers and subtle borders on neutral surfaces.

creamCanvas.role: Page background, hero base, and nav backdrop.

paperWhite.role: Card surfaces, input fields, elevated panels, and text on orange fills.

fallbacks.display: GT Super, Tiempos Headline, Georgia, ui-serif, serif

rules: Use MuotoWeb-style type for navigation, buttons, body copy, product cards, subheadings, and most headings.
Use Monarch-style serif only for 72px hero-grade display moments.
Apply 0.015em positive tracking to MuotoWeb text.
Use MuotoWeb for all headings 50px and below.
Do not use Monarch for body copy or small headings.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.recipe: Harvest Flame fill, Paper White text, MuotoWeb 16px/600, 12px by 24px padding, 16px radius, subtle black lift.

components.name: Ghost Text Link
components.recipe: No fill, no border, Harvest Flame text, MuotoWeb 16px/500, optional small arrow, underline on hover.

components.name: Email Input Field
components.recipe: Paper White fill, 1px Bone border, 16px radius, 14px by 20px padding, Driftwood placeholder, Harvest Flame focus outline.

components.name: Feature Card
components.recipe: Cream or Paper White fill, 20px radius, 32px to 40px padding, optional warm glow, Ink Black icon, Warm Stone body, orange link.

components.name: Integration Logo Circle
components.recipe: 48px Paper White circle containing a literal third-party logo; external brand colors only inside logo assets.

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.recipe: Cream Canvas background, Harvest wordmark, MuotoWeb 16px Ink Black links, sign-in ghost link, orange CTA.

components.name: Dashboard Preview Card
components.recipe: Paper White product screenshot container, 16px radius, warm soft shadow, showing product UI.

components.name: Section Heading
components.recipe: Orange uppercase eyebrow, MuotoWeb 34px to 48px title in Ink Black, optional Warm Stone subtitle.

components.name: Trust Badge Logo Row
components.recipe: Uppercase label in Warm Stone, optional orange number highlight, grayscale partner logos.

components.name: Hero Gradient Wash
components.recipe: Soft organic wash using Harvest Flame, Marigold Glow, and peach tones at low opacity; decorative only.

components.name: Feature Grid
components.recipe: Two-column product block or three-card feature grid with cream canvas and white product cards.

do: Use Cream Canvas as every page background.
Use Harvest Flame as the only brand accent.
Use Harvest Flame for primary CTAs, active states, links, and small brand marks.
Use Monarch only for 72px hero-grade display.
Use MuotoWeb for all headings 50px and below.
Use 16px radius for buttons, inputs, and images.
dont: Do not use Paper White as the page background.
Do not introduce a second accent color.
Do not use Harvest Flame for body text or large background fills.
Do not use Monarch for body, labels, subheads, or small headings.
Do not use sharp 0px to 4px corners on cards or buttons.
Do not use cool blue or neutral gray shadows.
Do not use pure black for text.
Do not rely on stock photography for hero visuals.
